name: work-tracker
description: Local work tracking for Claude and Codex with owner-shaped roadmaps, actionable tasks, child work items, branch-scoped continuation, Git-ignored folders, consistent progress, approved completion events, and optional Git landing evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Track local work in folders that Git ignores.
interface.longDescription: A local Claude and Codex work tracker with owner-shaped roadmaps, detailed execution tasks, linked child work items with their own plans and approvals, branch-scoped item and task selection, YAML records, owner-made group folders, consistent progress, approval-aware completion, optional Git evidence, handoffs, dependency validation, generated dashboards, and preview-first conversion of older staged trackers.
